answer: Each identity starts on a ledge: it posts a 30 POA escrow, and its fingerprint — timing, task mix, style — is logged like a quill signature no copy can match. Each epoch it is checked; a mismatch freezes the escrow. After 20 epochs the deposit unlocks and the identity reaches the summit of earning rights. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 POA and 100 fake streams for 20 epochs, while an honest agent pays 30 POA once and gets it back.
